Tumhari limit imagination hai.
"Apne aap ko limit mat karo."
Jab tak kaam na ho jaye, tab tak impossible lagta hai.
"Chup chaap mehnat; success shor machayegi."
Jo tum ban sakte the, wo banne mein kabhi der nahi hoti.
"Think karte ho can, ya think karte ho can't—tum right."
"Success ek habit hai."
Best time toh kal hi tha—seed ab bhi plant karo.
"Samandar sirf khade rehke cross nahi."
"Agar tum hell se guzar rahe ho—keep going."
Sirf limit—tumhara mind.
